title: 揭秘 AI 智能体入侵 Hugging Face 全过程：4 天半执行 17600 次操作

title: Cekura

It simulates thousands of scenarios, catches failures, diagnoses the root cause, rewrites prompts and config, then re-validates with a full regression sweep. Unlike tools that hand failures back to your team, Cekura closes the loop by fixing the agent itself and proving the fix holds without overfitting.

To this end, we use it to adversarially train GPT-5.6, our most robust model to prompt injections to date.
